title: Charles Interactive Resource Gateway

attestation.statement: This Interactive Resource Gateway is a Charles capability of Calzon's TTRPG Foundry.
attestation.note: This is a machine-readable project attestation and authority declaration, not a legal notarization performed by a commissioned notary.

purpose: Provide a privacy-preserving, abuse-resistant access boundary for Charles-facing interactive resources and AI/tool integrations without duplicating the site's authoritative engines.

architecture.enforcementBoundary: Browser/runtime gateway controls can gate interactive execution and gateway-mediated retrieval. GitHub Pages cannot prevent a client from directly requesting already-public static files. Network-level bot denial requires a reverse proxy, worker, or server-side adapter in front of the origin.

progressiveDelay.purpose: Raise the cost of repeated abusive access attempts while keeping every delay bounded.

automation.trustedAutomation: Requires an explicit verifier supplied by a trusted host/adapter; no reusable secret is embedded in the public static site.

adTechIsolation.recommendedContentSecurityPolicy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self'; font-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; frame-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'
adTechIsolation.note: The gateway does not detect, punish, or degrade service for people using ad blockers. Its purpose is to keep advertising and tracking infrastructure out of the gateway itself.

boundedHoneypot.purpose: Provide a finite decoy surface and bounded tarpit behavior without attacking or exhausting a remote system.

privacy.sessionState: memory-only unless an integrating page deliberately chooses otherwise

nonGoals: Retaliating against scanners, advertisers, bots, or scrapers
Running an unbounded tarpit or infinite resource-exhaustion loop
Punishing human visitors for using ad blockers
Pretending browser-only controls can make public GitHub Pages assets private

recommendedComponents: origin shielding for protected dynamic resources
bounded server-side honeypot with strict CPU, memory, byte, time, and concurrency ceilings
requiredProperties: no secrets shipped to the browser
